theme_archetype.description: Authority, clarity, and truth. Perfect for a complex B2B workflow builder. Employs stark white/off-white bases with high-contrast signal colors for functional node states. Completely avoids teal and purple.
theme_archetype.emotional_tone: Professional, precise, trustworthy, and heavily structured.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy with generous negative space in dashboards, and hyper-dense, pixel-perfect alignment in the canvas editor.
layout_spacing.dashboard: MODE B: 'Control Room' Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6. Cardless approach with 1px borders.
layout_spacing.canvas: Full viewport width/height. Floating control panels use 'Grid Borders' style with solid backgrounds and sharp 1px borders. NO Glassmorphism on the canvas to maintain visual clarity of edges.
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for dashboard containers. Use p-3 or p-4 for node internals.

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders: flat white background, 1px border-slate-200, no shadow. Hover state: border-slate-400.
surface_strategies.floating_panels: Canvas sidebars and floating menus: bg-white with a hard 1px border-slate-900 and a brutalist shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0_rgba(15,23,42,1)]).
surface_strategies.inputs_forms: Shadcn components heavily customized to have 0px border-radius (rounded-none), thick 1px border-slate-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-slate-900.

component_rules.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50.
component_rules.tables: Dense. border-b on rows. left-aligned text. No alternating row colors, rely on 1px borders for structure.
component_rules.navigation: Sidebar navigation with flat, non-rounded active states. Left border accent (border-l-2 border-slate-900) for active item.

react_flow_node_styling.container: bg-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-md min-w-[240px] overflow-hidden shadow-[2px_2px_0_rgba(15,23,42,0.1)] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
react_flow_node_styling.header: px-3 py-2 border-b-2 border-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2. The background color matches the specific 'node_colors' palette. Text is high-contrast.
react_flow_node_styling.handles: w-3 h-3 bg-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-full hover:bg-blue-100. Left handle = target, Right handle = source.
react_flow_node_styling.edges: SVG-based edges. Default: stroke-slate-400 stroke-2. Selected/Active: stroke-blue-600 stroke-[3px] animated path.
react_flow_node_styling.validation_warning: Absolute positioned badge on node corner: bg-yellow-400 border border-slate-900 text-slate-900 text-xs px-1.

iconography.style: Regular or Bold weight. Used strictly for function, not decoration. Every node type requires a distinct Phosphor icon in its header.

instructions_to_main_agent: You must build a hybrid application: a SaaS dashboard (ZappZen) and a complex visual flow editor.
Implement multi-tenant logic carefully (Super Admin vs. Tenant Admin).
Use @xyflow/react for the canvas. Implement all 10 node types as custom React components matching the 'react_flow_node_styling' rules. Do not use default xyflow node styles.
Canvas must include zoom, pan, minimap, and snap-to-grid.
For WhatsApp QR mock, create a clean modal or section with a mocked QR SVG and a 'connected' state toggle.
Human handoff inbox should be a 3-pane layout: Contacts List -> Chat History -> Contact Info.
Always apply data-testid to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='create-bot-button').
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all icons.
All copy should be in Portuguese (e.g., 'Criar Robô', 'Conectar WhatsApp', 'Caixa de Entrada').
Do not use card components for standard layout blocks; use pure div containers with 1px borders (Grid Borders style).
CRITICAL: Write standard .js/.jsx files (not .tsx) as the environment does not support typescript.
